title: Check: Crude Oil and Fractional Distillation (2)

questions.stem: As the chain length of hydrocarbons in crude oil increases, what happens to their viscosity and flammability?
questions.explanation: As chain length increases, viscosity increases because longer molecules tangle together more, making the liquid flow less easily. Flammability decreases because longer chains are harder to vaporise, requiring more energy to ignite. Short-chain fractions like petrol are runny and very flammable.
